Name: MMOSkillQuestPack
Description: MMO Skill Tree - zone questlines for Orbis: quest-giver NPCs at world spawn and in the Howling Sands hand out two campaign arcs (Emerald Wilds 1-15, Howling Sands 18-35) with branching NPC dialogue, turn-ins, zone-scoped hunts, campaign achievements, and a Kweebec Nightmares arc with its own reward gear when that minigame is installed.
